Name: NPC Helper
Author: TamKungZ
Description:
[size=6]NPC Helper (v1.0.2)[/size]

[color=orange]Status: Experimental / Early Prototype[/color]

NPC Helper is an experimental framework that explores an alternative approach to creating custom NPCs for Stardew Valley. Using TOML configuration files, it provides a structured way to define characters, dialogue, schedules, and assets without requiring extensive knowledge of the game's internal systems.

This is a learning project and personal exploration of Stardew Valley modding systems. It is not intended to replace or compete with established tools, but simply to exist as another option in the modding ecosystem.

[list]
[*][url=https://tamkungz.github.io/documentation/npc-helper/]Documentation[/url]
[/list]

[u]What This Is[/u]
[list]
[*]An experimental approach to NPC creation using TOML files
[*]A personal project for learning Stardew Valley modding systems
[*]An alternative workflow that might appeal to some creators
[*]A work in progress with no guarantees of long-term support
[/list]

[u]What This Is NOT[/u]
[list]
[*]A replacement for Content Patcher or other established tools
[*]A production-ready framework for commercial projects
[*]An officially supported or endorsed modding solution
[*]A complete solution for all NPC-related needs
[/list]

[u]Core Concepts[/u]
[list]
[*]Define NPCs using TOML configuration files
[*]Dialogue follows Stardew Valley's standard key format
[*]Dynamic sprite/portrait variants based on location/season
[*]Separate files for dialogue, schedules, and localization
[*]Runtime registration without file patching
[/list]

[u]Installation[/u]
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI
[*]Place in Mods folder
[*]Create TOML files for your NPCs
[*]Launch game - NPCs register automatically
[/list]

[u]Basic Structure[/u]
[code]
YourNPC.toml # Main definition
Dialogue.toml # Dialogue lines
Schedule.toml # Daily schedule
sprite.png # Character sprite
portrait.png # Dialogue portrait
[/code]

[u]Version 1.0.2 Changes[/u]
[list]
[*]Dialogue system now uses Stardew Valley's native format
[*]Removed legacy [condition] syntax
[*]Gift responses moved to Dialogue.toml
[*]Improved localization support
[*]Better asset variant handling
[/list]

[u]Important Notes[/u]
[list]
[*]This is an experimental project
[*]Breaking changes may occur
[*]Not all features may work as expected
[*]Primarily maintained for educational purposes
[/list]

[u]Compatibility[/u]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+
[*]Stardew Valley 1.5.6+
[*]No dependencies
[/list]

[u]Support[/u]
This is a personal project with limited support. For issues:
[list]
[*]Check the documentation first
[*]Include game version and SMAPI log
[*]Understand this is experimental software
[/list]

[u]Credits[/u]
